content: भङ्ग [भञ्ज्-भावादौ घञ्] .²1 Breaking, breaking down, shattering, tearing down, splitting, dividing; भङ्गः स जिष्णोर्धृतिमुन्ममाथ <ls>Ki. 17. 29</ls>. वार्यर्गलाभङ्ग इव प्रवृत्तः <ls>R. 5. 45</ls>. .²2 A break, fracture, breach. .²3 Plucking off, lopping; आम्रकलिकाभङ्ग <ls>Ś. 6</ls>. .²4 Separation, analysis. .²5 A portion, bit, fragment, detached portion; पुष्पोच्चयः पल्लवभङ्गभिन्नः <ls>Ku. 3. 61</ls>; <ls>R. 16. 16</ls>. .²6 Fall, downfall, decay, destruction, ruin; as in राज्य˚, सत्त्व˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 Breaking up, dispersion; यात्राभङ्ग <ls>Māl. 1</ls>. .²8 Defeat, overthrow, discomfiture, rout; भग्ने भग्नमवाप्नुयात् <ls>Pt. 4. 41</ls>; प्रसभं भङ्गमभङ्गुरोदयः (नयति) <ls>Śi. 16. 72</ls>. .²9 Failure, disappointment, frustration; तत्पूर्वभङ्गे वितथप्रयत्नः <ls>R. 2. 42</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>); आशाभङ्ग <ab>&c.</ab> .²10 Rejection, refusal; अभ्यर्थनाभङ्गभयेन स्पधुर्माध्यस्थमिष्टेऽप्यवलम्बतेऽर्थे <ls>Ku. 1. 52</ls>. .²11 A chasm, fissure. .²12 Interruption, obstacle, disturbance; निद्रा˚, गति˚ <ls>Ki. 17. 29</ls>. .²13 Non-performance, suspension, stoppage. .²14 Taking to flight, flight. .²15 .³({%a%}) A bend, fold. .³({%b%}) A wave; क्षौमे भङ्गवती तरङ्गतरले फेनाम्बुतुल्ये वहन् <ls>Nāg. 5. 2</ls>; ज्वालाभङ्गैः (= Wavelike flames) <ls>Nāg. 5. 21</ls>. .²16 Contraction, bending, knitting; ग्रीवाभङ्गाभिरामम् <ls>Ś. 1. 7</ls>; so भ्रूभङ्ग <ls>U. 5. 36</ls>. .²17 Going, motion. .²18 Paralysis. .²19 Fraud, deceit. .²20 A canal, water-course. .²21 A circumlocutory or round-about way of speaking or acting; see भङ्गि. .²22 Hemp. .²23 (With Buddhists) The constant decay taking place in the universe; constant change. .²24 (With Jainas) A dialectical formula beginning with स्यात्.
